title: Thresholding audio-frame energy
description: You can follow a background estimate into a Boolean activity mask.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You estimate noise_floor with the twentieth percentile of energy. Multiplying it by the supplied factor sets the threshold used to mark is_speech.

steps.question: Does a frame exactly equal to threshold count as speech?
steps.answer: No. The comparison uses greater than, so only energy above threshold produces True.

steps.description: You plot audio and shade frame regions where is_speech is True. The chart labels these regions as detected speech.
The recording prints noise floor 9.81e-05 and threshold 1.96e-03. You see speech detected in 50% of frames under this threshold rule.
